findings.issue: Tables defined in migrations but never queried in API code: IF, if
findings.remediation: Either add API endpoints for these tables or remove them from migrations
findings.impact: Dead schema increases migration complexity and storage cost

findings.issue: Bulk invite operations not wrapped in a Supabase RPC transaction — partial invite failure leaves inconsistent state
findings.remediation: Move bulk invite logic into a Supabase RPC function with BEGIN/COMMIT/ROLLBACK
findings.impact: If one invite fails mid-batch, earlier invites are already committed — org membership state is inconsistent
